summary: @servicetitan/ajax-handlers preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), unpacks it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, obfuscated with a large numeric/string constant array and a rotation function so that no URLs, exports, or behavior are recoverable without executing the decoder. The file name bears no relation to AJAX handling. `setup.mjs` itself uses obfuscator.io-style hex-named identifiers and string-lookup dispatch objects (e.g. `_0x488df8 from "fs"`, `_0x52943e from "https"`, per-call `_0x19328d = { YCZJE:..., QkQej: "--version" }` maps). An AJAX-handler library has no legitimate reason to pull a second language runtime at install time, and executing the payload under Bun bypasses Node-based inspection. On `npm install`, the installer's shell runs attacker-controlled obfuscated code delivered via a non-Node runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
